text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian constitutional court asks the government to remove flags of foreign countries in front of the Gostivar town hall. Constitutional court president Milan Netkov said foreign flags can be flown in Macedonia only under strictly determined conditions.
- Leader of PDP party Arben Dzaferi said in response to the constitutional court demand the issue of flags should be resolved as soon as possible.
- The Macedonian police discovers some thirty refugees and illegal workers from Albania and eastern European countries every day.
- Ukrainean Foreign Minister Gennady Udovenko praises Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov for wisdom and courage.

- Small opposition parties -- the Democratic Party of Macedonia and party for Macedonian Action MAAK -- unite into the Democratic Party of Macedonia. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
